svg.title: A position outside the picture
svg.desc: A study of Johann Elias Ridinger's Stags in a Landscape. Two fine rust-colored lines lead from the alert deer in the foreground toward an empty circle outside the picture. A note records the artist's first reading of a reclining deer as a body that had fallen.
svg.text: A landscape notices someone before it tells us who.
The foreground animals raise their heads as if sensing an intruder;
the distant animals feed and rest, undisturbed. I put that presence here.
Johann Elias Ridinger, Stags in a Landscape, early to mid-18th century. Pen and brown ink, brush and brown wash.
The lines and circle are my additions. Source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, object 1974.110; public-domain image.
